objective: Require every discussion point to present bounded context, ranked alternatives, multidimensional confidence, implications, formal evidence, and an independent user disposition.
assumptions: Coordinator owns task identity and revision
AWG preserves one disposition per point
private prompts and transcripts stay outside public state
unknowns: A future UI may batch points without coupling them
invariants: Each point has ranked alternatives, evidence gaps, three confidence dimensions, implications, and formal-check references
Each response is bound to the packet task revision
An added proposal is evaluated before selection
One point's disposition cannot authorize another
acceptance_predicates: Missing alternatives, confidence, revision, or added-proposal evaluation fails closed
